### 1. Python 3.11+ Safe Merged-Branch Pruner
```python
import subprocess

PROTECTED = {"main", "develop", "master"}

def list_merged_branches(base: str = "develop") -> list[str]:
    """Return local branches fully merged into base, excluding protected branches."""
    out = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "branch", "--merged", base],
        capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", check=True,
    ).stdout
    branches = [line.lstrip("* ").strip() for line in out.splitlines() if line.strip()]
    return [b for b in branches if b not in PROTECTED and not b.startswith("(")]
```

### 2. Safe Cleanup & Issue Close Sequence
